purpose: Test random-seed stability and fixed two-seed averaging after weaker RankSim strengths failed to improve the existing RankSim ensemble
hypothesis: An independently initialized RankSim1 model can reduce seed-specific errors when averaged with the original; matched MSE distinguishes generic model averaging from RankSim-specific value
single_change: Base training RNG seed20261028 to seed20261102; this changes initialization, dropout and training draws as one RNG factor
seed_selection: Fixed now, no seed search or selecting the best seed using outer outcomes
labels: Original left/right GDI only; no synthetic or normal=100 labels
paired_control: Each new-seed MSE/RankSim pair uses exactly equal initial states and extracted windows/sides/order. The two arms then optimize their own frozen objectives
fit_seed_formula: base_seed+outer*100+(inner if inner is not None else 50)
epoch_selection: For each seed/arm/outer, choose earliest minimum internal MAE weighted by the actual validation-person counts138/139. Use only the other four folds; refit on all outer-training people

ensemble.weight_selection: Only outer-training inner OOF person-equal MAE, tie1e-12 smaller w; no cross-arm winner selected on outer labels
ensemble.inner_predictions: Every component excludes both outer f and inner j. Average old/new same(f,j) predictions before choosing w. Fixed epoch100 inner cache, each model uses its own frozen train-only OLS
ensemble.outer_predictions: Actual fixed existing-best bagged predictions; each additional arm uses own internally selected refit predictions, average corrected seed predictions without refitting another calibrator
ensemble.known_mismatch: Inner single-model baseline vs outer bagged baseline; fixed100 inner epoch vs selected outer refit epoch. Keep explicit and unchanged from the existing comparison

secondary_comparisons: new RankSim vs matched new MSE
MSE ensemble gain vs RankSim ensemble gain

pilot.device_checks: Each assigned physical GPU synthetic train/save/resume/replay; UUIDs distinct
pilot.local_gate: Server GPU/CPU64 and localCPU64 score difference<1e-4, real per-epoch samples/IDs/scale/OLS/checkpoint SHA; all checks before main
pilot.runtime_gate: Estimate remaining full tasks and fixed max100epochs from actual pilot; must fit remaining allocation with margin, otherwise hold and report, never shorten silently

submission_order: implement unchanged trainer plus isolated seed setting
CPU synthetic end-to-end and full person-boundary checks
check actual resources and account limits
register real jobIDs/unique task locks and update own automation

expected_resources.basis: Prior RankSim strength pilot26.23sec/epoch and182.2MiB; conservative schedule estimate, not a reservation or measured new pilot

artifacts: all4823-like actual epoch raw predictions/metrics and sampled-index fingerprints
fixed ensemble comparisons and selection audit
method_adaptation: Use only independent RNG initialization/shuffling and equal prediction averaging, not the paper's NLL variance head/adversarial training. No claim to reproduce its full method or uncertainty estimates
